focused_regression_validation.includes: Actual disposable train/evaluate CLI; missing model binding, altered refs digest, stage, partition, source manifest and training refs rejected.

status: actual-data public replay proof independently verified
trust_limits: Published reference digest authenticates consistency of selected labels, not semantic truth.
Source/context hashes verify supplied original text, not that a citation establishes the claimed value.
User-trusted manifests can be jointly rewritten; this is not an adversarial signing scheme.
Matching confusion metrics establishes reproduction in the tested environment, not binary-deterministic model serialization or general detection safety.
Positive cited lines only; no background false-positive estimate.
verified_fix: Optional reference-model binding now requires a nonempty valid model digest; absent model and absent reference-model fields cannot match each other. Replayed training freezes bind the new serialized model to original reference model, training references, partition and source manifest.
